name: @arena/expert-intake-service
description: Arena expert-intake reference service (Work Order C003; issue #110). In-process orchestration over @arena/expert-intake: start/resume/abandon/timeout/submit/assess interview operations over an in-memory session store (the A015-fabric house pattern for reference services), with injected ports — the interviewer model adapter (lock rule 10), the A006 registry proposal port and the A007 qualification claim port (spec/service-boundaries.md: submissions hand the IntakeProfile to the public ports, never direct writes into another surface's state). Commands carry REQUIRED idempotency keys; cross-tenant reads fail closed; tampered session state fails closed; claims are input to qualification, never an access grant.
